text:
scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
backup.sh
cleanup.sh
collect.sh
export.sh
fetch.sh
import.sh
lint.sh
pack.sh
prune.sh
report.sh
sync.sh
upload.sh

stderr:

arguments.command: cd scripts && for f in *.sh; do if [ "$(head -n 1 "$f")" = "#!/bin/bash" ]; then sed -i '1a set -euo pipefail' "$f"; else echo "SKIP (no bash shebang): $f"; fi; done; head -n 2 *.sh
